listings.name: Hudson Accessible Vans
listings.summary: Side-entry vans that did JFK and Midtown hotel pickups without a lift drama. Driver helped with the Q'Straint belts.
listings.description: Booked a side-entry van from JFK Terminal 4 to a Midtown hotel. The ramp cleared my power chair, tie-downs were solid, and the driver waited at the curb without rushing. Contributed so the next traveler can find a real WAV instead of a sedan that 'should work.'

listings.name: River North Accessible Suites
listings.summary: Roll-in shower actually rolled in. Front desk had a shower chair waiting. Garage stall was tight for a side-entry van.
listings.description: Stayed two nights. The advertised accessible king had a true roll-in, grab bars, and a 36-inch door. The garage 'van' stall was short — we unloaded on the street instead. Service dog was welcomed with a relief map.

listings.name: Little Havana Courtyard Stay
listings.summary: Zero-step courtyard, wide bedroom door, accessible restroom. Shower is a low step, not roll-in.
listings.description: Host added a compact ramp to the courtyard. Bedroom door is 32.5 inches. Bathroom works with a walker; the shower has a 3-inch curb so it is not roll-in. Street parking only.

listings.name: Orange County Mobility Vans
listings.summary: Theme-park and MCO transfers in a lowered-floor van. Driver knew which hotel curb cuts actually work.
listings.description: Used them for MCO to International Drive and a park day. Rear ramp, four tie-downs, and they text when they are 10 minutes out. One van had a sticky lift — they swapped vehicles without charging extra.

listings.name: Alberta Arts Bungalow
listings.summary: Rear ramp, wide hall, roll-in shower the host built themselves. Driveway fits a side-entry van.
listings.description: The listing photos undersold it. Host built a 1:12 ramp to the back door and a genuine roll-in with a handheld shower. Doorways are 34 inches. Driveway is level gravel packed tight enough for my tires.

listings.name: Rainey Street Accessible Lodge
listings.summary: Elevator, roll-in shower, lowered sink. Nightclub street — ask for a quiet-side room. Service animals OK.
listings.description: Booked the ADA king. Roll-in worked, elevator was reliable, and the sink and peephole were at a usable height. The street is loud on weekends; request a courtyard room. Valet can hold a van space if you call ahead.
